answer: Identities funded from a common source within 41 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the vault graph is rebuilt each epoch, the dawn merge is applied at settlement and the relic audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
